title: Copilot Notebooks: add Teams meetings as references
summary: Hold: the description of access to existing notebooks after disabling the policy omits an important restriction. Microsoft says notebook sharing links stop working when creation is disabled; the roadmap facts and documented control routes otherwise check out.

claims.claim: Copilot Notebooks now support Teams meetings as references.
claims.quote: Copilot notebooks now include Teams meetings as knowledge sources

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Users can link meeting transcripts, notes, chats and shared files within notebooks.
claims.quote: allowing users to link meeting transcripts, notes, chats, and shared files within their notebooks.

claims.claim: The release notes describe this feature in the entry dated August 25, 2026.
claims.quote:
## August 25, 2026
### OneNote
1. **Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks** [Android, Windows, iOS, Web]

claims.claim: The release notes say notebooks previously supported only files as references.
claims.quote: Previously, notebooks only supported files as references.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes grounding Copilot on project discussions and decisions to improve presentations and briefs.
claims.quote: enabling users to ground Copilot on the discussions, decisions, and context that drive their work

claims.claim: Users open a Copilot notebook in Microsoft 365, select Add reference and choose a Teams meeting from recent meetings.
claims.quote:
Open a Copilot notebook in Microsoft 365.
Select 'Add reference' and choose a Teams meeting from your recent meetings.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Adding meeting references is a user-opt-in capability, not an action performed automatically for everyone.
claims.quote: Select 'Add reference' and choose a Teams meeting from your recent meetings. Searched: Copilot Notebooks Teams meeting references admin policy disable Graph PowerShell default; opened admin policies and TCM Copilot resources; no meeting-specific enabling switch found.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not document the copy-versus-link storage mechanism for an added meeting.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks meeting references sharing permissions transcript requirements copied linked; opened release notes and cpcn-permission. The release notes say linked, but neither describes the underlying copy or storage mechanism.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not explain how meeting permissions or notebook sharing govern referenced meeting content.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks meeting references sharing permissions transcript requirements copied linked; "Copilot Notebooks" "meeting" "permissions" "transcript". Opened cpcn-permission and release notes; found file-sharing rules, not meeting-reference permission rules.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Copilot Notebooks can be shared.
claims.quote: **Copilot Notebooks** can be shared.

claims.claim: Notebooks are stored in a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container shared with Loop My workspace.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks are stored in a user-owned SharePoint Embedded container that's also used by Loop My workspace.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing: Indirect costs
claims.claim: Notebook storage counts toward the organisation's SharePoint quota.
claims.quote: Storage counts against your organization's SharePoint quota.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: The permissions page says notebook recipients gain access to all referenced files.
claims.quote: Anyone you share with gains access to all the files referenced in the notebook.

claims.claim: Access to linked files is granted automatically where possible.
claims.quote: Access to linked files is granted automatically where possible. Some linked files might remain restricted if permissions can't be updated.

claims.claim: Copilot Notebooks do not support external sharing.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks don't support external sharing.

claims.claim: Conditional Access applies to the whole Microsoft Copilot app rather than Notebooks alone.
claims.quote: Only applies at the app level. Because Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks are features of the Microsoft Copilot app, Conditional Access applies to the entire app at m365.cloud.microsoft.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Information Barriers do not protect content stored in the SharePoint Embedded containers used by Notebooks.
claims.quote: Information Barriers are **not supported** for content stored in SharePoint Embedded containers. Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks use SharePoint Embedded for storage.

claims.claim: Notebooks have no container sensitivity labels because they share a container with all Copilot Pages.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks don't have container sensitivity labels because they share a container with all Copilot Pages.

claims.claim: The feature documentation describes no autonomous action.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks Teams meeting references admin policy disable Graph PowerShell default; Copilot Notebooks meeting references sharing permissions transcript requirements copied linked. Opened release notes and read roadmap description; both describe users adding references.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling the creation policy hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app.
claims.quote: The Pages module is visible in the Microsoft Copilot app, but the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Scope: Prerequisites; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling the creation policy prevents users in scope from creating new notebooks.
claims.quote: When creation is disabled, users are unable to create new Copilot Pages or Notebooks.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling the policy does not delete existing items.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted.

claims.claim: After disabling the policy, existing notebooks can still be viewed and edited with permission.
claims.quote: Users can still view and edit existing items if they have permission. ... Important: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks don't work when creation is disabled via the policy in this article.
claims.fix: After 'existing items are not deleted and can still be viewed and edited with permission', add: 'However, sharing links to Copilot Notebooks do not work when creation is disabled.' This qualification is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/loop/cpcn-admin-configuration.

claims.claim: Changes take up to 90 minutes where policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: Changes take up to 24 hours where no policy configurations existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.claim: Purview eDiscovery covers Copilot Notebooks content.
claims.quote: Purview eDiscovery: Supported for search/collection, review (Premium license required), and export as HTML (Premium license required) or original format.

claims.claim: Retention policies configured for all SharePoint sites cover Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Retention policies from Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management configured for all SharePoint sites are enforced for all Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: Audit logs cover Copilot Notebooks content.
claims.quote: Audit logs: Available for all events. Retained, exportable, and streamable to third-party tools. ... Copilot Notebooks create and update `.pod` files to manage content.

claims.quote:

Users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost

claims.quote: Users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The TCM resource reference also requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, unlike the requirements page's Copilot Chat wording.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks also require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate licence, meter or price for meeting references is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks meeting references licensing pricing meter government GCC availability; "Copilot Notebooks" "meeting references" "meter" "price". Read requirements, TCM resources, licence options and Copilot pay-as-you-go meters excerpt; no meeting-reference charge found.

claims.claim: The compliance summary states there is no admin control for individual container quota limits.
claims.quote: There's no admin control to set quota limits on individual containers.

claims.claim: Documentation does not state government-cloud availability specifically for meeting references.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks meeting references licensing pricing meter government GCC availability. Read release notes and Microsoft Copilot service-description excerpts; the latter lists Notebooks in government clouds, not the meeting-reference capability separately.

claims.claim: A user without a OneDrive site cannot create notebooks when OneDrive creation has been disabled for them.
claims.quote: If your organization disabled the creation of OneDrive, regardless of the setting noted here, these people in your organization can't create Copilot Pages or Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: The required meeting contents, including whether a transcript is mandatory, are not documented for meeting references.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Notebooks meeting references sharing permissions transcript requirements copied linked; "Copilot Notebooks" "meeting" "permissions" "transcript". Read release notes and requirements; results for Copilot in Teams do not establish Notebook meeting-reference prerequisites.

claims.claim: The Notebooks Cloud Policy route is Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. Select Policy Management. Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. From the Choose the scope dropdown list ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the Notebooks baseline once using applyOnce mode.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors
An active `applyOnce` monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: The preview baseline uses resourceType microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote:
"resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks", "resourceVersion": 1, "properties": { "value": "1" }
`0` disables the setting; `1` enables the setting.

claims.claim: The preview TCM route supports tenant-level policies only and fails if the target setting is configured in any group-level policy.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. ... If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and `applyOnce` fail for that resource.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in user role for remediation and applyOnce.
claims.quote: **AI Administrator** is the least-privileged role for the signed-in user for remediation and `applyOnce`; don't assign that user-role requirement to the service principal.

claims.claim: The TCM service principal needs delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite.
claims.quote:
microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks | CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite | AI Administrator
These requirements are separate from the calling app's `ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All` delegated permission.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Cloud Policy can target groups, with a higher-priority enabled group overriding an all-users disabled group in the documented two-group pattern.
claims.quote: In Cloud Policy, lower priority numbers are evaluated first. With this configuration, users in Group A get the policy Enabled, while all other users in Group B get it Disabled.

claims.claim: The transcription setting is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $false prevents meeting transcription under the selected policy.
claims.quote:
### -AllowTranscription
Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/teams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy to sources; its reference explicitly supports the printed $false value. Keep the existing call and control docs link.

claims.claim: Teams transcription policy is not documented as governing what Copilot Notebooks can reference.

claims.claim: The admin policies page lists creation and code-preview settings, neither specific to meeting references.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks check the following Cloud Policy settings: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks; Enable code previews for AI-generated content in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot Pages.

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for applyOnce.
claims.quote: Creating an `applyOnce` monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated `ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All` permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: The Copilot Pages and Notebooks baseline uses resourceVersion 1.
claims.quote: All resources on this page use `resourceVersion: 1` and are singletons.

claims.claim: properties.value is the string 0 to disable the Notebooks setting or 1 to enable it.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks through Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Copilot Actions. `0` disables the setting; `1` enables the setting.
